question: Which Indian actor received the ‘Crystal Award’ at the World Economic Forum 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deepika Padukone.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bollywood actor **Deepika Padukone** has been awarded the **Crystal Award 2020** at the annual meeting of the World Economic Forum.
 
• Deepika Padukone won the prize for her **leadership in raising mental health awareness**.
 
• The World Economic Forum Annual Meeting took place in **Davos-Klosters, Switzerland** from **21-24 January 2020.**
 
• The theme of the meeting was, **“Stakeholders for a Cohesive and Sustainable World.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
